examples.en: The unit tests all passed, but an integration test caught the mismatch between the two services.
examples.zh: 单元测试全过了，但有一个集成测试发现了两个服务之间对不上的地方。

examples.en: Our integration tests run against a real database in a container, not an in-memory one.
examples.zh: 我们的集成测试跑在容器里的真实数据库上，而不是内存数据库。

situation.zh: 面试官问：单元测试都过了，你怎么确认各个模块合在一起也没问题？
situation.en: We have integration tests that exercise the service together with its real database and message queue.

examples.en: We keep only a handful of end-to-end tests because they're slow and expensive to maintain.
examples.zh: 端到端测试我们只留了少数几个，因为它们又慢、维护成本又高。

examples.en: The end-to-end test logs in, places an order, and checks the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 这个端到端测试会登录、下一个订单，然后检查确认邮件。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么验证用户从登录到下单的整条流程是通的？
situation.en: We have an end-to-end test for each critical user journey, and it runs against staging before every release.

entries.note: 常缩写成 E2E test。作定语时三个词之间加连字符：end-to-end。

examples.en: Every time we fix a bug, we add a regression test so it can't come back unnoticed.
examples.zh: 每修一个 bug，我们都会加一个回归测试，免得它悄悄又出现。

situation.zh: 同事修了一个线上 bug，但 PR 里只有代码改动。你想建议：
situation.en: Could we add a regression test for this? I'd like to be sure it stays fixed.

entries.note: regression 本身指“原来好的功能被改坏了”：This change introduced a regression.

entries.zh: 不稳定的测试（时过时不过）

examples.en: That flaky test fails about one run in ten, usually because of a timing issue.
examples.zh: 那个不稳定的测试大概十次里挂一次，通常是时序问题导致的。

examples.en: We quarantine flaky tests so they don't block everyone else's merges.
examples.zh: 我们会把不稳定的测试隔离出来，免得卡住其他人的合并。

situation.zh: 同事问：CI 红了，但失败的那个用例和你的改动完全无关，怎么回事？你想说：
situation.en: I think it's a flaky test. I reran the job and it passed without any changes.

entries.note: flaky 读 /ˈfleɪki/。也可以直接说 The test is flaky. 处理方式常说 quarantine（隔离）。

examples.en: Our test coverage is around eighty percent, but the number alone doesn't tell you much.
examples.zh: 我们的测试覆盖率在 80% 左右，但光看这个数字说明不了太多。

examples.en: I'd rather improve test coverage on the billing module than chase a hundred percent everywhere.
examples.zh: 我宁愿提高计费模块的测试覆盖率，也不想在所有地方都追求 100%。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们会要求覆盖率必须到 100% 吗？
situation.en: No. We care more about meaningful test coverage on critical paths than about hitting a specific number.

entries.note: 也说 code coverage。“被测试覆盖到”说 be covered by tests。

examples.en: With continuous integration, every commit is built and tested automatically within a few minutes.
examples.zh: 有了持续集成，每次提交都会在几分钟内自动构建并测试。

situation.zh: 面试官问：十几个人同时改一个代码库，你们怎么尽早发现互相冲突的改动？
situation.en: We rely on continuous integration. Everyone merges small changes daily, and each merge triggers a full build and test run.

entries.note: 缩写 CI，逐个字母读。口头常说 CI is red / green（CI 挂了 / 过了）。

examples.en: Our CI pipeline runs linting, unit tests, and a build before anyone can merge.
examples.zh: 我们的 CI 流水线会先跑静态检查、单元测试和构建，通过了才能合并。

examples.en: The pipeline takes forty minutes, so I'm looking at running the test stages in parallel.
examples.zh: 流水线要跑四十分钟，所以我在研究把几个测试阶段并行起来。

situation.zh: 同事问：你的 PR 为什么还没合？
situation.en: The CI pipeline is still running. It usually takes about twenty minutes.

entries.note: 流水线里的每一步叫 stage 或 job。“流水线挂了”说 The pipeline failed.

examples.en: I broke the build yesterday because I forgot to commit a new file.
examples.zh: 我昨天把构建搞挂了，因为有个新文件忘了提交。

examples.en: If you break the build, fixing it takes priority over everything else.
examples.zh: 如果你把构建搞挂了，修好它比其他任何事都优先。

situation.zh: 你刚合进去的改动导致主干编译不过，大家都被卡住了。你在群里说：
situation.en: Sorry, I broke the build. I'm reverting my change now and will fix it properly on a branch.

entries.note: 名词说法：a broken build、a build failure。

examples.en: We build once and promote the same build artifact from staging to production.
examples.zh: 我们只构建一次，然后把同一个构建产物从预发推到生产。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么保证预发上测过的东西和最终上线的是同一份？
situation.en: We never rebuild for production. The pipeline publishes one build artifact, and every environment deploys that exact image.

entries.note: artifact 读 /ˈɑːrtɪfækt/，英式拼写是 artefact。Docker 镜像、jar 包、打包后的前端文件都算 artifact。

entries.zh: 持续交付（不是持续部署）

examples.en: We practice continuous delivery, so the main branch is always in a releasable state.
examples.zh: 我们实行持续交付，所以主干始终处于可发布的状态。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个改动写完之后，你们多快能把它发到线上？
situation.en: With continuous delivery, any commit that passes the pipeline can go out the same day with one click.

entries.note: continuous delivery 指随时可以发布，发不发由人决定；continuous deployment 是通过流水线后自动发到生产。两者都缩写成 CD。

examples.en: I refactored the payment module before adding the new feature, which made the change much smaller.
examples.zh: 加新功能之前我先重构了支付模块，这样后面的改动小了很多。

examples.en: Let's not refactor and change behavior in the same PR.
examples.zh: 别在同一个 PR 里既重构又改行为。

situation.zh: 面试官问：接手一段很难改的老代码，你会怎么做？
situation.en: I'd add tests around it first, then refactor in small steps so I can verify nothing breaks.

entries.note: 重构指不改变外部行为、只改善内部结构。名词是 refactoring；口头也直接把 refactor 当名词用：a big refactor。

entries.zh: 偿还技术债（动词短语，p 开头）

examples.en: We set aside twenty percent of each sprint to pay down technical debt.
examples.zh: 我们每个迭代留出 20% 的时间来偿还技术债。

examples.en: We took on some technical debt to hit the launch date, and we paid it down the following quarter.
examples.zh: 为了赶上线日期我们欠了一些技术债，下一个季度把它还掉了。

situation.zh: 产品经理问：为什么这个季度要排两周不做新功能？
situation.en: We need to pay down technical debt in the checkout code. Right now every change there takes twice as long as it should.

entries.note: debt 的 b 不发音，读 /det/。口头常说 tech debt。“欠下技术债”是 take on / accumulate technical debt。

examples.en: I split the function into three smaller ones purely for readability.
examples.zh: 我把这个函数拆成三个小函数，纯粹是为了可读性。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里问：这里为什么不用那个一行的写法？你想回复：
situation.en: I went with the longer version for readability. The one-liner is clever, but it takes a minute to figure out.

entries.note: 形容词 readable：This is much more readable. 重音在 -bil- 上：/ˌriːdəˈbɪləti/。

examples.en: We chose the simpler design for maintainability, even though it's slightly slower.
examples.zh: 为了可维护性，我们选了更简单的设计，尽管它稍微慢一点。

situation.zh: 面试官问：性能更好的方案和更简单的方案，你一般怎么选？
situation.en: Unless performance is a real problem, I optimize for maintainability, because code is read far more often than it's written.

entries.note: 形容词 maintainable。注意名词 maintenance 的拼写和读音：/ˈmeɪntənəns/，重音在第一个音节。

examples.en: A function with eight parameters is a code smell; it's probably doing too much.
examples.zh: 一个函数有八个参数就是一种代码坏味道，它多半做的事情太多了。

situation.zh: 同事问：这个类两千行了，但功能都正常，有必要动它吗？
situation.en: A class that size is a code smell. It's not a bug, but it usually means several responsibilities are tangled together.

entries.note: code smell 不是 bug，而是提示设计可能有问题的信号。可数：a code smell。

entries.zh: 迭代（Scrum 里固定周期的那种，s 开头）

examples.en: We work in two-week sprints and demo what we've built at the end of each one.
examples.zh: 我们按两周一个迭代来做，每个迭代结束时演示做出来的东西。

examples.en: That ticket won't fit in this sprint, so let's schedule it for the next one.
examples.zh: 那个任务这个迭代塞不下了，排到下一个迭代吧。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们团队的开发节奏是怎样的？
situation.en: We run two-week sprints. Each sprint starts with planning and ends with a demo.

entries.note: 相关会议：sprint planning（计划会）、sprint review（评审会）。“这个迭代内”说 in this sprint。

entries.zh: 待办列表（Scrum 里按优先级排的需求池）

examples.en: The backlog had over three hundred tickets, so we closed everything older than a year.
examples.zh: 待办列表里有三百多个任务，所以我们把一年以上的全关掉了。

situation.zh: 同事提了个不错的优化建议，但这个迭代已经排满了。你想说：
situation.en: Good idea. Let's add it to the backlog and prioritize it at the next planning meeting.

entries.note: backlog 也泛指“积压”：a backlog of support tickets。

examples.en: We estimated the login rework at five story points, but it turned out to be closer to thirteen.
examples.zh: 登录改造我们估的是 5 个故事点，结果实际更接近 13 个。

situation.zh: 新同事问：你们估任务的时候，为什么不直接说要几天？
situation.en: We use story points because they measure relative effort and complexity, not hours, so they don't turn into deadlines.

entries.note: story point 衡量相对工作量，不等于人天。团队每个迭代完成的点数叫 velocity（速率）。

entries.zh: 估算（工作量；名词和动词同形）

examples.en: My estimate is two weeks, assuming the API contract doesn't change.
examples.zh: 我的估算是两周，前提是接口约定不变。

examples.en: It's hard to estimate this until we've done a quick spike.
examples.zh: 在做一次快速的技术预研之前，这个很难估。

situation.zh: 经理问：这个需求大概要做多久？你还没细看，只能给个粗略的数。
situation.en: My rough estimate is three to four weeks, but I'd like a day to break it down before I commit.

entries.note: 名词读 /ˈestɪmət/，动词读 /ˈestɪmeɪt/。spike 指为了搞清楚不确定性而做的限时预研。

entries.zh: 需求梳理（Scrum 的例行活动，两个词）

examples.en: In backlog refinement, we break large stories down and make sure the acceptance criteria are clear.
examples.zh: 在需求梳理会上，我们把大的故事拆小，并确认验收标准是清楚的。

situation.zh: 计划会开了三个小时，因为很多需求到会上才第一次讨论细节。你建议：
situation.en: Let's do backlog refinement a few days before planning, so the stories are already sized and understood.

entries.note: 以前叫 backlog grooming，现在多说 refinement。“验收标准”是 acceptance criteria。

examples.en: We test every release in the staging environment before it goes to production.
examples.zh: 每个版本上生产之前，我们都会先在预发环境里测一遍。

examples.en: The bug didn't show up in staging because the data there is much smaller.
examples.zh: 这个 bug 在预发环境没暴露出来，因为那边的数据量小得多。

situation.zh: 面试官问：新版本上线前，你们在哪里做最后的验证？
situation.en: In a staging environment that mirrors production as closely as possible, including the same infrastructure config.

entries.note: 口头常省略成 staging：It works in staging.

examples.en: We deploy to production several times a day, and each deploy takes about ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我们一天往生产环境部署好几次，每次大约十分钟。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个改动合并之后，到用户能用上，中间要经过什么？
situation.en: Once it's merged, the pipeline runs the tests and we deploy to production automatically, usually within the hour.

entries.note: production 口头常说 prod。deploy 也作名词：the last deploy，和 deployment 通用。

examples.en: We cut a release branch every other Friday and only allow bug fixes on it.
examples.zh: 我们每隔一周的周五拉一个发布分支，上面只允许修 bug。

situation.zh: 新同事问：马上要发版了，我的新功能还能往哪里合？
situation.en: Merge it into main. The release branch was cut yesterday, so only fixes go in there now.

entries.note: “拉分支”用 cut：cut a release branch。把修复挑到发布分支上叫 cherry-pick。

examples.en: We moved to trunk-based development, so nobody keeps a branch open for more than a day or two.
examples.zh: 我们改成了主干开发，所以没人会让一个分支开着超过一两天。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么避免长期分支合并时的大量冲突？
situation.en: We do trunk-based development. Everyone merges small changes into main daily, and unfinished work stays behind a flag.

entries.note: trunk 就是主干分支（main）。对立面是长期存在的功能分支：long-lived feature branches。

examples.en: The library follows semantic versioning, so a major version bump means breaking changes.
examples.zh: 这个库遵循语义化版本，所以主版本号升了就意味着有不兼容的改动。

situation.zh: 同事问：这个依赖从 2.4 升到 3.0，直接升会不会有问题？
situation.en: Probably. They follow semantic versioning, so a new major version means there are breaking changes to check.

entries.note: 版本号是 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH：不兼容改动升 major，加功能升 minor，修 bug 升 patch。常缩写成 semver。

entries.zh: 静态检查工具（查代码风格和常见错误，l 开头）

examples.en: The linter flags unused variables, so those never make it into a pull request.
examples.zh: 静态检查工具会标出没用到的变量，所以这类问题进不了 PR。

situation.zh: 同事总在评审里指出别人的缩进和命名问题，大家都嫌烦。你建议：
situation.en: Let's have the linter enforce those rules in CI, so reviews can focus on the actual logic.

entries.note: 动词是 lint：lint the code。报出来的问题叫 a lint error / warning。

entries.zh: 代码规范（两个词，第二个词 s 开头）

examples.en: We wrote down our coding standards so new hires don't have to guess what the team expects.
examples.zh: 我们把代码规范写了下来，这样新人就不用猜团队的要求是什么。

situation.zh: 面试官问：团队里每个人的写法都不一样，你怎么处理？
situation.en: I'd agree on coding standards as a team first, then automate as much of the enforcement as we can.

entries.note: 也说 coding conventions。偏格式和命名的那份文档叫 style guide。

examples.en: Static analysis caught a possible null dereference that none of our tests had covered.
examples.zh: 静态分析发现了一处可能的空指针解引用，我们的测试都没覆盖到。

situation.zh: 面试官问：除了测试，你们还有什么手段在上线前发现 bug？
situation.en: We run static analysis on every pull request, which catches things like null dereferences and resource leaks.

entries.note: static analysis 指不运行代码就做的检查，范围比 linter 大，也包括类型检查和安全扫描。

examples.en: We wrote an architecture decision record explaining why we chose Postgres over DynamoDB.
examples.zh: 我们写了一份架构决策记录，说明为什么选了 Postgres 而不是 DynamoDB。

situation.zh: 新同事问：当初为什么选了这个消息队列？现在没人说得清了。你建议以后：
situation.en: For choices like this, let's write an architecture decision record, so the context and the alternatives are captured.

entries.note: 缩写 ADR，逐个字母读。一份 ADR 通常包括背景、决定、考虑过的备选方案和后果。

entries.term: keep the docs up to date

examples.en: We keep the docs up to date by changing them in the same PR as the code.
examples.zh: 我们把文档和代码放在同一个 PR 里改，这样文档就能保持更新。

situation.zh: 同事抱怨：按照文档搭环境，一半的步骤都是错的。你想说：
situation.en: Yeah, nobody owns it. We should keep the docs up to date by fixing them whenever we touch that code.

entries.note: 过时的文档说 outdated 或 out of date。docs 是 documentation 的口语说法；documentation 不可数，不能说 a documentation。
